Look at what we are dealing with yet again. The progressive establishment is exploiting the very real tragedy of crime in our communities to advance their big-government agenda and chip away at our fundamental constitutional rights. They are pointing the finger at the 2026 State of the State agenda, whining about corporate manufacturers and systemic inequalities, as if law-abiding citizens and businesses are the ones responsible for the collapse of public order. 

What is the actual measure they are pushing? It requires guns sold in New York to be designed so they cannot be easily modified and establishes criminal penalties for these conversions. Instead of demanding basic law and order, cracking down on actual criminals, and upholding personal responsibility, these leftists want more bureaucratic regulations and tighter control over manufacturers. They even dismiss their own policies as a mere "Band-Aid" while demanding a "radical institutional overhaul" and the dismantling of traditional institutions. Let's be honest about what this is really about—it has nothing to do with safety. It is a calculated effort to tear down the foundations of our society and erode our freedoms. True public safety is built on strong families, moral responsibility, and backing our law enforcement, not on red tape and socialist attacks on industry.
